register.lab_note: GBM lag-columns experiment (Kass's trajectory hypothesis; labels and grading identical to the GBM focus build): LightGBM 3-class on lag-augmented matrix features, thresholds pre-registered at 0.40/0.40, graded on the standard 3 windows vs champion and buy-and-hold ($+718). Arm E (lag focus-72 (11 base x [t, lag1..3, d1, d3] + 6 return lags), balanced class weights): FAIL, agg -2135 vs champ -2063, P&L $-4,885, 59 round trips, WF acc 0.5902 vs 0.6692 baseline (run 25). Arm F (lag focus-72, SMOTE inside each training fold (scaler->SMOTE)): PASS, agg -1871 vs champ -2063, P&L $-4,417, 40 round trips, WF acc 0.5901 vs 0.6692 baseline (run 26). Arm G (lag all-60 (60 base x [t, lag1, d1] + 6 return lags = 186), balanced class weights): FAIL, agg -2523 vs champ -2063, P&L $-6,107, 53 round trips, WF acc 0.5946 vs 0.6692 baseline (run 27). Best lag arm by OOF balanced accuracy: G; importance kind shares: {'now': 40.7, 'lag': 23.0, 'ret': 5.1, 'delta': 31.1}. Full report: refs/gbm-lag-2026-10-22.md
